journal.bunnyland.blossom_fox.descriptio: A playful fox with a cherry blossom behind its ear and a tail so fluffy it sheds petals as it runs. It loves to pounce and spin when it's happy.
journal.bunnyland.blossom_fox.habitat: Cherry groves, flower forests and birch woods.
journal.bunnyland.blossom_fox.tip: Blossom Foxes sleep through the day and wake at dusk.
journal.bunnyland.cherry_blossom_bird.de: A round songbird with a crest of cherry petals. It sings sweet melodies in the morning and can't help dancing whenever music plays nearby.
journal.bunnyland.cherry_blossom_bird.ti: Play a music disc near a Cherry Blossom Bird.
journal.bunnyland.cloud_kitty.descriptio: A kitten wrapped in a ruff of cloud with a cloud-puff on the tip of its tail. It drifts down softly instead of falling, purrs when petted, and sometimes leaves gifts when its owner wakes up.
journal.bunnyland.cloud_kitty.habitat: Meadows, plains, cherry groves and windswept hills.
journal.bunnyland.cloud_kitty.tip: Sleep in a bed near your Cloud Kitty to find a little present in the morning.
journal.bunnyland.cotton_bunny.descripti: A round little puff of a bunny with a cotton-ball tail. Every so often it sheds a tuft of soft Cotton Fluff, which makes wonderful stuffing for pet beds.
journal.bunnyland.cotton_bunny.habitat: Meadows, flower forests, plains and cherry groves.
journal.bunnyland.cotton_bunny.tip: Wild bunnies are shy: sneak to get close, then offer a Bunny Biscuit.
journal.bunnyland.dreamy_hamster.descrip: A sleepy hamster in a starry nightcap. It naps all day, stuffs its cheeks until they're round when it eats, and blows little dream bubbles in its sleep.
journal.bunnyland.dreamy_hamster.habitat: Plains, sunflower plains, meadows and savannas.
journal.bunnyland.dreamy_hamster.tip: Dreamy Hamsters are night owls. They nap during the day and get busy at night.
journal.bunnyland.honey_bear.description: A cuddly cub with honey-dipped ears and a best friend: a little bee that orbits its head. It sniffs out full beehives and licks them clean, and stands up for a hug when happy.
journal.bunnyland.honey_bear.habitat: Forests, birch forests and flower forests, anywhere bees buzz.
journal.bunnyland.honey_bear.tip: Honey Bears are sturdy friends. Tame one with a Honey Cake.
journal.bunnyland.lavender_bunny.descrip: A floppy-eared lop who smells faintly of lavender and keeps a sprig tucked behind one ear. Cuddling a happy Lavender Bunny is so calming that it soothes your wounds.
journal.bunnyland.lavender_bunny.habitat: Flower forests, meadows and cherry groves.
journal.bunnyland.lavender_bunny.tip: Pet a happy Lavender Bunny (sneak + use) to receive a few seconds of Regeneration.
journal.bunnyland.moon_bunny.description: A night-loving bunny whose markings glow like moonlight. A tiny crescent moon follows it everywhere. It floats down gently from great heights and never takes fall damage.
journal.bunnyland.moon_bunny.habitat: High meadows, groves and snowy slopes, close to the sky.
journal.bunnyland.moon_bunny.tip: Moon Bunnies nap during the day; look for them awake at night with a Moon Cookie.
journal.bunnyland.moon_deer.description: A graceful night deer with starry spots and softly glowing antlers. It is very shy and bounds away from anyone who isn't sneaking.
journal.bunnyland.moon_deer.tip: Moon Deer sleep during the day. Approach slowly while sneaking.
journal.bunnyland.pastel_axolotl.descrip: A smiley axolotl with frilly gradient gills and a heart on its back. It swims gracefully and is just as happy waddling on land beside you.
journal.bunnyland.pastel_axolotl.tip: Pastel Axolotls never dry out, so you can take them anywhere.
journal.bunnyland.rainbow_butterfly.desc: A butterfly with wings painted in rainbow bands. It flutters from flower to flower, rests to show off its wings, and sometimes helps new flowers bloom.
journal.bunnyland.rainbow_butterfly.habi: Flower forests, meadows, cherry groves and plains, on sunny days.
journal.bunnyland.rainbow_butterfly.tip: Offer Flower Nectar to befriend one. Tamed butterflies flutter after you.
journal.bunnyland.snowball_bunny.descrip: So round and so fluffy it is mostly snowball. Snowball Bunnies never feel the cold, can't freeze, and hop across powder snow without sinking.
journal.bunnyland.snowball_bunny.habitat: Snowy plains, snowy taigas, ice spikes and groves.
journal.bunnyland.snowball_bunny.tip: Their white fur hides them well in the snow. Look for rosy cheeks!
journal.bunnyland.strawberry_bunny.descr: Speckled with golden seeds and crowned with a leafy calyx, this berry-sweet bunny can't resist ripe berry bushes and will happily nibble any it finds.
journal.bunnyland.strawberry_bunny.habit: Flower forests, meadows and sunny birch woods.
journal.bunnyland.strawberry_bunny.tip: Tame it with a Strawberry Tart. It loves sweet berries.
journal.bunnyland.strawberry_mouse.descr: A tiny mouse who wears a strawberry as a hood. It scampers away from cats, including Cloud Kitties, but once tamed it is the bravest little friend.
journal.bunnyland.strawberry_mouse.habit: Plains, meadows, forests and flower forests.
journal.bunnyland.strawberry_mouse.tip: Mice are quick! Sneak and hold a Strawberry Tart so they come to you.
journal.bunnyland.tiny_swan.description: An elegant little swan who glides along rivers. Cygnets follow their parents in a neat little line, and a happy swan raises its wings into a heart.
journal.bunnyland.tiny_swan.tip: Swans love water. They float, and they paddle after you through rivers.
